steps.text: Your rows are at the bottom: melee, ranged and siege. The AI's are at the top.

hand.name: Plane
description: Muster: plays at once every card of its group from your deck and hand.

hand.name: Human
description: Bond: its strength is multiplied by the number of units in its row that share its bond.

hand.name: War Horn
description: Goes in the horn slot of one of your rows, and doubles the strength of its units, but not of a Legend.

hand.name: Informant
description: Spy: goes on the opponent's side, where its strength counts for them. Whoever plays it draws 2 cards.

hand.name: Medic
description: Medic: plays at once a unit, not a Legend, from your own discard pile.

description: Removes every weather card in play.
